meta.groep: 8 adults (3 couples + 2 singles) and 2 kids under 2
meta.mogelijkheden.toelichting: Beach and restaurants are based on the top-pick house. Padel was looked up per region; 'unknown' means we couldn't find or confirm a court.
meta.carriers.toelichting: Most likely airline on the Saturday; colours are an approximation of the livery, without logos or names on the aircraft.
meta.kidscheck_uitleg: Not a wish list but a check: how easy and safe is this with two kids under 2?
meta.extra_kosten_kids: Kids under 2 fly on a lap at an infant fare per flight; if a child has turned 2 by the return trip, they need their own seat. Rent two child car seats with the cars. Check current fares with the airline.
meta.scorecriteria.zon_zee: Chance of warm weather and warm sea water in late September
meta.scorecriteria.value: What you get for your money: quality of the house per euro and local price levels
meta.scorecriteria.eten: Quality and atmosphere of food and dining
meta.scorecriteria.natuur: Beautiful nature and outdoor activities within a short drive
meta.scorecriteria.bier: Price of a beer (0.5 l draught in a restaurant, Numbeo)
meta.scorecriteria.reisgemak: Flight, number of flights and transfer with kids under 2
meta.scorecriteria.avontuur: How different and adventurous it feels
meta.bronnen.huizen: Airbnb.nl, retrieved on 11 Oct 2026. Filters: 18 to 25 Sept 2027, 8 adults and 2 infants, at least 5 bedrooms, pool. Prices are total prices including fees. 54 to 90 results were scanned per area; the top pick was chosen on rating, number of reviews, child facilities (cot, high chair, fenced garden), air con, outdoor dining and location.
meta.bronnen.vluchten: Skyscanner route pages and Google Flights, Oct 2026. The week of 18 Sept 2027 can't be booked yet; the price is a realistic estimate per adult return, without hold luggage.
meta.bronnen.klimaat: Climate averages for the second half of September (indicative).
meta.bronnen.prijzen_lokaal: Numbeo, country averages Oct 2026: 0.5 l draught beer and dinner for 2 in a mid-range restaurant.
meta.bronnen.veiligheid: Dutch government travel advice (Nederland Wereldwijd), Oct 2026: Portugal, Spain, Croatia, Albania, Malta, Greece and Italy green; Turkey yellow (terror threat mainly in big cities, wildfires in summer, limited healthcare outside big cities).
meta.bronnen.kosten: Cost per adult = house divided by 8 + flight + €70 hold luggage + 3 hire cars divided by 8 + food and outings (7 days x (half a dinner for 2 + €25)). Costs for the kids are added on for the parents.
meta.bronnen.mogelijkheden: Our own estimate based on the location of the house, the listings and local information. Padel looked up via club websites and local news sources (Oct 2026).
meta.bronnen.pils: Beer price: Numbeo, 0.5 l draught in a restaurant, country average Oct 2026. A round for the guys is 5 beers.
meta.mogelijkheden.categorieen.stad.naam: Day out in a big city
meta.mogelijkheden.categorieen.hooghoude: Jogo bonito: space for keepy-uppies at the house
meta.landen.Portugal.intro: Four very different sides of Portugal: cliffs, lagoons, palaces and the wine harvest.
meta.landen.Albanië.intro: Three versions: city and culture, beach, or a rugged coast. The most adventurous country on the list.
meta.landen.Spanje.intro: One spot in Spain: tapas, padel in every village and a city around the corner.
meta.landen.Kroatië.intro: One spot in Croatia: the shortest trip from door to pool, with islands as a day trip.
meta.landen.Turkije.intro: One spot in Turkey: the warmest sea on the list and endless meze tables.
meta.landen.Malta.intro: One spot on Malta: stone farmhouses, ancient temples and a village square around the corner.
meta.landen.Griekenland.intro: One Greek island: tavernas, turquoise bays and few crowds.
meta.landen.Italië.intro: One spot in Italy: baroque towns, granita for breakfast and the best food on the list.
meta.landen.Italië.stekker: Type F, sometimes type L (travel adapter handy)
opties.algarve-west.tagline: Golden cliffs, caves and piri piri chicken, 40 minutes from the airport.
opties.algarve-west.sfeer: An easy, sunny week: lots of time at the house, the odd beach or cave, and grilled fish or piri piri chicken in the evening. Everything is well organised and close by.
opties.algarve-west.scores.zon_zee.1: Sun guaranteed, but the Atlantic is chilly (21°C).
opties.algarve-west.scores.value.1: Strong houses around €3,400, low restaurant prices.
opties.algarve-west.scores.eten.1: Grilled fish, cataplana and the piri piri chicken of Guia.
opties.algarve-west.scores.natuur.1: Cliffs, the Benagil cave and the Sete Vales trail.
opties.algarve-west.scores.cultuur.1: Silves and Lagos are nice, but it's still resort territory.
opties.algarve-west.scores.reisgemak.1: Lots of direct flights daily, short transfer.
opties.algarve-west.scores.veiligheid.1: Green travel advice, good roads and hospitals.
opties.algarve-west.scores.avontuur.1: Familiar ground for many Dutch people.
opties.algarve-west.onderscheid.plus.0: The most carefree travel picture on the list: lots of flights, short transfer, everything is there.
opties.algarve-west.onderscheid.plus.1: The strongest child-friendly house of all the options (Villa Charme).
opties.algarve-west.onderscheid.min.0: Coldest sea of all the beach options.
opties.algarve-west.onderscheid.min.1: Busy and touristy around Albufeira, little sense of discovery.
opties.algarve-west.mogelijkheden.strand: Praia Grande approx. 5 km away, 10 minutes by car.
opties.algarve-west.mogelijkheden.restau: Car needed; the village of Pêra is a few kilometres away.
opties.algarve-west.mogelijkheden.uitgaa: The Albufeira party strip is 20 minutes away, quieter terraces in Carvoeiro and Lagos.
opties.algarve-west.mogelijkheden.wijn.1: A few small wineries around Lagoa and Silves; no harvest culture.
opties.algarve-west.mogelijkheden.boot.1: Boat or kayak to the Benagil cave and along the cliffs.
opties.algarve-west.mogelijkheden.natuur: Clifftop trails such as the Sete Vales Suspensos and the Monchique mountains.
opties.algarve-west.mogelijkheden.stad.1: Faro and Lagos are small; Seville is a 2h30 drive.
Plenty of padel clubs in the Algarve.
opties.algarve-west.mogelijkheden.waters: Kayaking to caves, surfing on the west coast.
opties.algarve-west.mogelijkheden.kids.1: Zoomarine and water parks within 20 minutes.
opties.algarve-west.mogelijkheden.hoogho: Garden with football goals and a volleyball net.
opties.algarve-west.kidscheck.water: Atlantic, sometimes waves; the coves are calmer
opties.algarve-west.kidscheck.zorg: Good hospitals in Faro and Portimão
opties.algarve-west.huizen.11248947.waar: The most child-friendly house on the whole list: cot, toys for 0 to 2 years, playground and playroom, fully fenced garden, heated pool with pool cover, air con, gym and outdoor dining. 164 reviews with a 4.96.
opties.algarve-west.huizen.11248947.let_: It's 5 km from the beach (location score 4.59).
opties.algarve-west.huizen.18730627.waar: 500 m from the beach, sea view, fenced garden, cot and high chair. Highest location score (4.98).
opties.algarve-west.huizen.18730627.let_: Over €750 more expensive than Villa Charme.
opties.algarve-west.huizen.43119730.naam: Beach villa with heated rooftop pool
opties.algarve-west.huizen.43119730.waar: 6 bedrooms for €2,469, a 3-minute drive to the beach, 160 reviews.
opties.algarve-west.huizen.43119730.let_: The pool is on the roof: keep a close eye on toddlers.
opties.algarve-oost.subregio: Tavira, Olhão and the Ria Formosa
opties.algarve-oost.tagline: The authentic part of the Algarve: lagoon islands, fish markets and warmer water.
opties.algarve-oost.sfeer: Quiet and authentic: long days on car-free islands, fish markets and villages where it's mostly Portuguese visitors. Less spectacle, more savouring.
opties.algarve-oost.scores.zon_zee.1: Warmest water in Portugal and calm lagoon beaches.
opties.algarve-oost.scores.eten.1: Olhão fish market, octopus in Santa Luzia, oysters from the Ria.
opties.algarve-oost.scores.natuur.1: Ria Formosa with flamingos and islands without cars.
opties.algarve-oost.scores.cultuur.1: Tavira and Cacela Velha are the prettiest towns in the Algarve.
opties.algarve-oost.scores.reisgemak.1: Same flights as the Algarve, 20-minute transfer.
opties.algarve-oost.scores.avontuur.1: Portugal, but the least touristy stretch of coast.
opties.algarve-oost.onderscheid.plus.0: Best value for money in Portugal.
opties.algarve-oost.onderscheid.plus.1: Calm, shallow lagoon water: ideal with small children.
opties.algarve-oost.onderscheid.min.0: No spectacular cliffs like in the west.
opties.algarve-oost.onderscheid.min.1: The house is inland, it's a 20-minute drive to the beach.
opties.algarve-oost.mogelijkheden.strand: Lagoon beaches and islands approx. 20 minutes' drive plus a short boat ride.
opties.algarve-oost.mogelijkheden.restau: Car needed; São Brás is a few kilometres away.
opties.algarve-oost.mogelijkheden.uitgaa: Lively terraces in Tavira and Olhão, no nightlife.
opties.algarve-oost.mogelijkheden.wijn.1: A few wineries in the hinterland.
opties.algarve-oost.mogelijkheden.boot.1: Boats to Culatra, Armona and Ilha Deserta, trips through the Ria Formosa.
opties.algarve-oost.mogelijkheden.natuur: Ria Formosa nature park with flamingos.
Padel clubs in the Faro and Tavira area.
opties.algarve-oost.mogelijkheden.waters: Paddleboarding and kayaking in the lagoon.
opties.algarve-oost.mogelijkheden.kids.1: Shallow, calm lagoon water and the little train to Praia do Barril.
opties.algarve-oost.mogelijkheden.hoogho: Its own small football pitch at the house.
opties.algarve-oost.kidscheck.zwembad: On the roof: keep an extra eye out
opties.algarve-oost.kidscheck.water: Calm and shallow lagoon water, ideal
opties.algarve-oost.huizen.4319597.zwemb: Private, on the roof, heated, salt water, with pool cover
opties.algarve-oost.huizen.4319597.waaro: Most reviews of all the Portuguese options, 6 bedrooms, playground and football pitch, fenced garden, air con, outdoor dining. For €2,626.
opties.algarve-oost.huizen.4319597.let_o: Rooftop pool: keep a close eye on toddlers. Cot costs extra.
opties.algarve-oost.huizen.48536309.waar: Rural with a sea view, close to Tavira, cot and air con.
opties.algarve-oost.huizen.48536309.let_: Fewer reviews, no fenced garden mentioned.
opties.algarve-oost.huizen.48880100.waar: Old merchant's house with a ballroom, beautifully restored.
opties.algarve-oost.huizen.48880100.let_: Max. 9 guests, check whether the babies count; garden not fully fenced.
opties.sintra.tagline: Fairytale palaces, wild Atlantic beaches and Lisbon 40 minutes away.
opties.sintra.sfeer: Variety: palaces and Lisbon one day, the wild beach around the corner the next. Less of a pool holiday, more exploring.
opties.sintra.scores.zon_zee.1: Coldest sea (19°C) and a chance of sea mist on the coast.
opties.sintra.scores.value.1: Most expensive Portuguese option, houses around €4,500.
opties.sintra.scores.eten.1: Marisqueiras, pastéis de Belém, Colares wine and Lisbon.
opties.sintra.scores.natuur.1: Sintra hills, Cabo da Roca and a wild coastline.
opties.sintra.scores.cultuur.1: Pena Palace, Quinta da Regaleira and all of Lisbon.
opties.sintra.scores.reisgemak.1: Most flights of all the options, 40 minutes to the house.
opties.sintra.scores.avontuur.1: City break and beach in one, but familiar ground.
opties.sintra.onderscheid.plus.0: The most culture and city on the list.
opties.sintra.onderscheid.plus.1: The largest number of flights: easy to shift dates around.
opties.sintra.onderscheid.min.0: The least like a sun-and-pool holiday: chilly sea and sometimes mist.
opties.sintra.mogelijkheden.strand.1: Praia das Maçãs 350 metres away; chilly Atlantic sea.
Fish restaurants at Praia das Maçãs within walking distance.
opties.sintra.mogelijkheden.uitgaan.1: Bairro Alto in Lisbon 40 minutes away, Cascais is closer.
opties.sintra.mogelijkheden.wijn.1: Tastings in the old Colares wine region, and in Setúbal.
opties.sintra.mogelijkheden.boot.1: Trips on the Tagus or from Setúbal.
opties.sintra.mogelijkheden.natuur.1: The Sintra hills and the coast at Cabo da Roca.
opties.sintra.mogelijkheden.padel.1: Plenty of choice in the Lisbon and Cascais area.
opties.sintra.mogelijkheden.watersport.1: Surfing in Ericeira and at Guincho.
opties.sintra.mogelijkheden.hooghouden.1: Lawn in the front garden, plus the beach 350 metres away.
opties.sintra.huizen.19601941.waarom: Traditional villa with 6 bedrooms, large pool, sea view, fenced garden, 350 m from the beach.
opties.sintra.huizen.19601941.let_op: No cot or air con mentioned; ask the host.
opties.sintra.huizen.10655747.waarom: Cheaper, lots of reviews, child-friendly and close to the calmest and warmest bays around Lisbon.
opties.sintra.huizen.10655747.let_op: 45 minutes to Lisbon, further from Sintra.
opties.douro.subregio: Vineyard terraces between Régua and Pinhão
opties.douro.tagline: Right in the middle of the grape harvest: vineyard terraces, quintas and a day in Porto.
opties.douro.sfeer: Slow living among the vineyard terraces: long lunches, tastings, the harvest up close and views from the pool. No beach, but a real experience.
opties.douro.scores.zon_zee.1: Warmest days in Portugal (28°C), but no sea.
opties.douro.scores.eten.1: Wine tastings, harvest meals, Porto and port.
opties.douro.scores.natuur.1: UNESCO vineyard terraces and the river.
opties.douro.scores.bier.1: €2.50, though you'll mostly be drinking wine here.
opties.douro.scores.reisgemak.1: Shortest flight, but 1 to 2 hours of winding roads.
opties.douro.scores.avontuur.1: Not a beach holiday but a harvest experience.
opties.douro.onderscheid.plus.0: Unique timing: late September is the vindima (grape harvest).
opties.douro.onderscheid.min.0: No beach: the pool and the river are your water.
opties.douro.onderscheid.min.1: Longer, winding transfer with small children.
opties.douro.mogelijkheden.strand.1: No sea, but there are small river beaches.
opties.douro.mogelijkheden.uitgaan.1: Very quiet; for a night out you have to go to Porto (2 hours).
opties.douro.mogelijkheden.wijn.1: Late September is the vindima: grape harvest and grape treading at the quintas.
opties.douro.mogelijkheden.boot.1: Rabelo boats on the Douro from Pinhão and Régua.
opties.douro.mogelijkheden.padel.1: No court found in the immediate area.
opties.douro.mogelijkheden.kids.1: Boat trip and small river beaches; otherwise not much specifically for little ones.
opties.douro.mogelijkheden.hooghouden.1: Fenced garden, size of the lawn unknown.
opties.douro.kidscheck.zorg: Hospital in Vila Real, Porto 2 hours away
opties.douro.huizen.42961840.waarom: Modern 350 m² villa with three suites and panoramic views, cot and high chair, toys, fenced garden, air con. 142 reviews with a 4.97.
opties.douro.huizen.42961840.let_op: Just over 2 hours' drive from Porto.
opties.douro.huizen.732545486730973785.w: Cheapest strong house on the whole list, 1 hour from Porto, valley views, air con.
opties.douro.huizen.732545486730973785.l: Simpler house; check whether the pool is still open in late September.
opties.tirana.tagline: Buzzing capital, bunkers and bazaars, with Berat, Kruja and the beach as day trips.
opties.tirana.sfeer: A week with city energy: the house is the quiet base, Tirana and the day trips are the adventure. Eating out cheaply is the norm here.
opties.tirana.scores.zon_zee.1: Warm, but the sea is 45 minutes away.
opties.tirana.scores.value.1: Villas with a pool are expensive here, but food and outings are cheap.
opties.tirana.scores.eten.1: Cheap and good: byrek, tavë kosi, fresh vegetables, lively restaurants.
opties.tirana.scores.natuur.1: Dajti cable car, Lake Bovilla, mountains all around.
opties.tirana.scores.cultuur.1: Tirana, Bunk'Art, Kruja and the UNESCO town of Berat.
opties.tirana.scores.reisgemak.1: Direct flight, short transfer, fewer flights than Portugal.
opties.tirana.scores.veiligheid.1: Green travel advice, but hectic traffic and limited healthcare outside Tirana.
opties.tirana.scores.avontuur.1: The most undiscovered country on the list.
opties.tirana.onderscheid.plus.0: The most city and culture outside Lisbon, at the lowest local prices.
opties.tirana.onderscheid.plus.1: The heated pool with spa makes the house a treat even without the beach.
opties.tirana.onderscheid.min.1: The house is relatively expensive (€4,435) and Albanian traffic needs your attention.
opties.tirana.mogelijkheden.uitgaan.1: Blloku in Tirana: bars, clubs and terraces until late.
opties.tirana.mogelijkheden.wijn.1: Wineries around Berat and Tirana, small-scale.
opties.tirana.mogelijkheden.natuur.1: Mount Dajti with its cable car and Lake Bovilla.
opties.tirana.mogelijkheden.padel.1: Padel is popular in Tirana, with several clubs.
opties.tirana.mogelijkheden.kids.1: Parks and the cable car in Tirana.
opties.tirana.mogelijkheden.hooghouden.1: Large garden with pool; ask whether there is grass.
opties.tirana.kidscheck.zorg: Best healthcare in Albania is in Tirana
opties.tirana.huizen.1121870004199689834: Private, heated infinity pool with pool cover, plus jacuzzi
The only house around Tirana with 5 bedrooms, lots of reviews and the full works: heated pool, spa, table tennis, air hockey, barbecue, fenced garden, cot.
Above the budget target of €3,500 (€554 per person); location score 4.35.
opties.tirana.huizen.1456352605417698552: Perfect score, 10 minutes from the airport, €1,600 cheaper.
4 bedrooms: the two singles would share a room.
opties.durres.subregio: Golem and the bay of Durrës
opties.durres.tagline: Villa right on the beach, with Tirana and Berat within easy reach.
opties.durres.sfeer: A beach week, Albanian style: feet in the sand, fish on the promenade and Tirana or Kruja as an outing.
opties.durres.scores.zon_zee.1: Sea at 24°C, sandy beach on the doorstep.
opties.durres.scores.value.1: Beach villa for €3,409 and the lowest local prices.
opties.durres.scores.eten.1: Good fish and grilled food, less refined than Tirana.
opties.durres.scores.natuur.1: The coast is heavily built up; beautiful nature is an hour's drive away.
opties.durres.scores.cultuur.1: Roman amphitheatre, Tirana and Kruja as day trips.
opties.durres.scores.reisgemak.1: Direct flight, 45 minutes to the beach house.
opties.durres.scores.veiligheid.1: Green travel advice, traffic needs your attention.
opties.durres.scores.avontuur.1: Albanian seaside resort life, still few Dutch tourists.
opties.durres.onderscheid.plus.0: One of the few options with the beach truly on the doorstep.
opties.durres.onderscheid.plus.1: Cheapest combination of beach villa and nightlife in the whole overview.
opties.durres.onderscheid.min.0: The coast at Golem is packed with apartment blocks: not the picture-postcard Riviera.
opties.durres.onderscheid.min.1: The pool is seasonal: ask whether it is open in late September.
opties.durres.mogelijkheden.strand.1: Sandy beach right on the doorstep.
Beach restaurants and beach bars within walking distance.
opties.durres.mogelijkheden.uitgaan.1: Beach bars in Golem and Durrës; it gets quieter in late September.
opties.durres.mogelijkheden.natuur.1: Divjaka-Karavasta nature park an hour's drive away.
opties.durres.mogelijkheden.watersport.1: Swimming and paddleboarding; no snorkelling water.
opties.durres.mogelijkheden.kids.1: Shallow sandy beach right by the house.
opties.durres.mogelijkheden.hooghouden.1: The sandy beach on the doorstep is the pitch.
opties.durres.kidscheck.water: Shallow sandy beach on the doorstep
opties.durres.kidscheck.zorg: Hospital in Durrës, Tirana 45 minutes away
opties.durres.huizen.37109682.waarom: Right on the beach, 5 bedrooms each with its own bathroom, 3 floors, fenced garden, cot, air con, sea view.
opties.durres.huizen.37109682.let_op: Location score 4.44: busy seaside resort. Ask whether the pool is open in late September.
opties.durres.huizen.1298432057050427019: Quiet spot in the hills above Durrës, highest rating (4.97 for value for money).
Beach a few minutes' drive away.
opties.durres.huizen.48717163.waarom: On a quieter stretch of beach, 6 bedrooms.
opties.vlore.subregio: Orikum, Karaburun and the gateway to the Riviera
opties.vlore.tagline: Rugged mountains dropping into the sea, hidden coves by boat and the Llogara Pass.
opties.vlore.sfeer: Rugged and adventurous: the days revolve around boat trips to deserted coves and drives over the mountain pass to the Riviera. The house is the base.
opties.vlore.scores.value.1: Family villa for €3,643 and low local prices.
opties.vlore.scores.eten.1: Fresh fish and lamb, simple but good.
opties.vlore.scores.natuur.1: Karaburun, Sazan, the Llogara Pass and the beaches of the Riviera.
opties.vlore.scores.reisgemak.1: 2h15 drive from Tirana, partly mountain road.
opties.vlore.scores.veiligheid.1: Green travel advice, but the longest drive on Albanian roads.
opties.vlore.scores.avontuur.1: The most adventurous stretch of coast on the list.
opties.vlore.onderscheid.plus.0: Most beautiful nature of all the Albanian options, with boat trips to uninhabited coasts.
opties.vlore.onderscheid.plus.1: The real Riviera (Dhërmi, Gjipe) is an hour away.
opties.vlore.onderscheid.min.0: Longest transfer of all the options with small children.
opties.vlore.onderscheid.min.1: Only one strong house found: few fallback options.
opties.vlore.mogelijkheden.strand.1: Orikum's beaches are close by; the most beautiful coves are reached by boat or via the Llogara Pass.
opties.vlore.mogelijkheden.restaurants.1: A few restaurants in Orikum; more choice in Vlorë (30 min).
opties.vlore.mogelijkheden.uitgaan.1: Bars on the promenade in Vlorë.
opties.vlore.mogelijkheden.wijn.1: Winery in Narta, by the lagoon.
opties.vlore.mogelijkheden.boot.1: To Karaburun, the Haxhi Ali cave and Sazan island.
opties.vlore.mogelijkheden.natuur.1: Karaburun, the Llogara Pass and the Riviera.
opties.vlore.mogelijkheden.watersport.1: Snorkelling in clear water around Karaburun.
opties.vlore.mogelijkheden.kids.1: Beach and pool; few specific outings.
opties.vlore.mogelijkheden.hooghouden.1: Flower garden; ask whether there is grass.
opties.vlore.kidscheck.water: Clear and calm, pebbles and sand
opties.vlore.huizen.1364943.zwembad: Private lap pool with toys, seasonal
opties.vlore.huizen.1364943.waarom: Set up for families: cot, high chair, fenced garden, pool toys, air con, sea view and a balcony looking out on the mountains.
opties.vlore.huizen.1364943.let_op: The only strong house in this region. Ask about the pool in late September.
opties.spanje.subregio: Hills above Málaga and the Costa del Sol
opties.spanje.tagline: Tapas, padel in every village and Málaga 20 minutes away, with Ronda and Granada as day trips.
opties.spanje.sfeer: Carefree enjoyment: tapas and vermouth in Málaga, padel in the morning, afternoons by the pool with views over the valley.
opties.spanje.scores.value.1: Strong villas from €2,100 to €3,900, affordable tapas.
opties.spanje.scores.eten.1: Tapas, espetos (sardines on a skewer) and ajo blanco.
opties.spanje.scores.natuur.1: Caminito del Rey, El Torcal and the white villages.
opties.spanje.scores.cultuur.1: Málaga, Ronda and the Alhambra in Granada (1h30).
opties.spanje.scores.reisgemak.1: Lots of flights, 20 minutes to the house.
opties.spanje.scores.avontuur.1: Many Dutch people already know it.
opties.spanje.onderscheid.plus.0: Padel is everywhere here, with a court in almost every village.
opties.spanje.onderscheid.plus.1: Together with Lisbon, the most flights and the shortest transfer.
opties.spanje.onderscheid.min.0: The coast is busy and heavily built up.
opties.spanje.onderscheid.min.1: The least adventurous country on the list.
opties.spanje.mogelijkheden.strand.1: Beaches of Torremolinos and Benalmádena approx. 20 minutes away.
Car needed; villa on a hill.
opties.spanje.mogelijkheden.uitgaan.1: Tapas bars in Málaga 20 minutes away, Marbella a bit further.
opties.spanje.mogelijkheden.wijn.1: Wineries around Ronda (1 hour) and sweet wine from the Axarquía.
opties.spanje.mogelijkheden.natuur.1: Caminito del Rey and El Torcal.
opties.spanje.mogelijkheden.padel.1: Spain is the padel country par excellence.
opties.spanje.mogelijkheden.watersport.1: Paddleboarding and kayaking; no special snorkelling water.
opties.spanje.mogelijkheden.kids.1: Bioparc in Fuengirola and Selwo Marina.
opties.spanje.mogelijkheden.hooghouden.1: Large private garden; type of surface unknown.
opties.spanje.huizen.2359648.waarom: Most reviews on the whole list, panoramic views over the valley, toys for ages 0 to 2, high chair, fenced garden, air con. 20 minutes from the airport.
6 bedrooms with views over mountains and sea, playground and toys, for €2,100.
Garden not fully fenced; further from the beach.
Spacious family villa on a hectare of land at the foot of the Sierra de Mijas, fenced garden, air con.
Fewer reviews than the top pick.
opties.kroatie.tagline: Shortest trip from door to pool, islands as day trips and the birthplace of Zinfandel.
opties.kroatie.sfeer: Light and easy: swimming in the Adriatic, a boat to Hvar or Brač, and an evening stroll along the Riva in Split.
opties.kroatie.scores.zon_zee.1: 25°C and a sea of 23°C, slightly more changeable than further south.
opties.kroatie.scores.value.1: Villa with 5.0 from 130 reviews for €3,309; the widest choice of all options.
opties.kroatie.scores.eten.1: Peka, grilled fish, pršut and local wine.
opties.kroatie.scores.natuur.1: Krka waterfalls, the Cetina gorge and the islands.
opties.kroatie.scores.cultuur.1: Diocletian's Palace in Split and the UNESCO town of Trogir.
opties.kroatie.scores.reisgemak.1: 2h10 flight and 15 minutes to the house: the shortest trip of them all.
opties.kroatie.scores.avontuur.1: Familiar, but with islands that can still surprise.
opties.kroatie.onderscheid.plus.0: Shortest total travel time of all options: ideal with small children.
opties.kroatie.onderscheid.plus.1: Biggest supply of strong houses, so easy to switch to another.
opties.kroatie.onderscheid.min.0: Cooler and more changeable in late September than Turkey, Gozo or Sicily.
opties.kroatie.onderscheid.min.1: Split and the islands have tourist prices.
opties.kroatie.mogelijkheden.strand.1: Small pebble beaches and the Kaštela seafront within walking distance.
opties.kroatie.mogelijkheden.restaurants: Waterfront restaurants in Kaštel Lukšić, an estimated 10 minutes' walk.
opties.kroatie.mogelijkheden.uitgaan.1: Bars in and around Diocletian's Palace in Split, 20 minutes.
opties.kroatie.mogelijkheden.wijn.1: Kaštela is the cradle of Zinfandel (Crljenak Kaštelanski); tastings at small wineries.
opties.kroatie.mogelijkheden.boot.1: Ferries and trips to Hvar, Brač and Šolta.
opties.kroatie.mogelijkheden.natuur.1: Krka waterfalls (1 hour) and the Cetina gorge near Omiš.
opties.kroatie.mogelijkheden.padel.1: Padel centre in Kaštel Štafilić and several clubs in Split.
Kayaking, snorkelling and rafting on the Cetina.
opties.kroatie.mogelijkheden.kids.1: Playground at the house and quiet little beaches.
Large garden with play area; beach and promenade within walking distance.
opties.kroatie.huizen.19341867.waarom: Perfect score across 130 reviews. Large heated pool, jacuzzi, infrared sauna, table tennis, children's play area, cot, high chair, fenced garden, air con.
opties.kroatie.huizen.19341867.let_op: Pool is seasonal: ask whether it is open and heated in late September.
opties.kroatie.huizen.50868740.waarom: New-build villa near the UNESCO town of Trogir, playground, fenced garden, central air con.
opties.fethiye.subregio: Turquoise Coast between Fethiye and Kaş
opties.fethiye.tagline: Warmest sea on the list, endless meze spreads and villas at half the price.
opties.fethiye.sfeer: Warm, generous and very different from home: long breakfasts with meze, boat days around little islands and evenings by the harbour. Sun is almost guaranteed here.
opties.fethiye.scores.zon_zee.1: 31°C and a sea of 26°C: the surest bet on the list.
opties.fethiye.scores.value.1: Villa with heated pool, sauna and hammam for €2,060.
opties.fethiye.scores.eten.1: Turkish breakfast, meze and the Fethiye fish market: the ultimate sharing table.
opties.fethiye.scores.natuur.1: Ölüdeniz, the Saklıkent gorge, the Lycian coast and little islands by boat.
opties.fethiye.scores.cultuur.1: Lycian rock tombs, the ghost village of Kayaköy, Tlos and Patara.
opties.fethiye.scores.reisgemak.1: Longest flight, but approx. 4 direct flights a week; Saturday not certain.
opties.fethiye.scores.veiligheid.1: Yellow travel advice for all of Turkey; the coast is calm, the threat is mainly in big cities.
opties.fethiye.scores.avontuur.1: Different culture, different food, different landscape.
opties.fethiye.onderscheid.plus.0: Warmest sea and best value for money of all options.
opties.fethiye.onderscheid.plus.1: The best food for your style of long, shared meals.
opties.fethiye.onderscheid.min.0: Only option with yellow travel advice.
opties.fethiye.onderscheid.min.1: Fewest direct flights and longest flight time.
opties.fethiye.mogelijkheden.strand.1: Çalış and Ölüdeniz a 15 to 25 minute drive away.
opties.fethiye.mogelijkheden.restaurants: Car needed; quiet location in the hills.
opties.fethiye.mogelijkheden.uitgaan.1: Fethiye harbour and old town, bars in Hisarönü.
opties.fethiye.mogelijkheden.wijn.1: Not much of a wine culture; there is raki though.
opties.fethiye.mogelijkheden.boot.1: Day trip around the 12 islands, boats from Ölüdeniz.
Snorkelling, kayaking and paragliding above Ölüdeniz.
opties.fethiye.mogelijkheden.kids.1: Calm water in the Ölüdeniz lagoon.
opties.fethiye.kidscheck.warmte: Hot (31°C): shade and a midday rest needed
opties.fethiye.huizen.16980777.naam: Luxury villa with heated pool, sauna and hammam
opties.fethiye.huizen.16980777.waarom: Quiet with mountain views, heated pool, hot tub, sauna and hammam, playground, fenced garden, cot, air con. For €2,060.
opties.fethiye.huizen.16980777.let_op: Beach is a 15 to 20 minute drive away.
opties.fethiye.huizen.6373817.rol: Alternative: most reviews and sea view
opties.fethiye.huizen.6373817.waarom: 5 suites with sea view above Kaş, the prettiest town on the coast. 138 reviews.
opties.fethiye.huizen.6373817.let_op: 2 hours' drive from Dalaman; no fenced garden listed.
opties.fethiye.huizen.51382651.waarom: Perfect score, playground and fenced garden, close to restaurants.
opties.gozo.tagline: Stone farmhouses, temples older than the pyramids and a village square round the corner.
opties.gozo.sfeer: Village life and relaxed: in the evening you stroll to the square, by day you choose between pool, red beach, temples or a boat to Comino.
opties.gozo.scores.value.1: Strong houses around €3,700, restaurants relatively pricey.
opties.gozo.scores.eten.1: Ftira, local cheeses, rabbit stew and fresh fish; long meals on the village square.
opties.gozo.scores.natuur.1: The red beach of Ramla, Dwejra and Comino's Blue Lagoon.
opties.gozo.scores.cultuur.1: Ġgantija temples, the citadel of Victoria and Valletta.
opties.gozo.scores.reisgemak.1: Lots of flights, but with a ferry on top.
opties.gozo.scores.veiligheid.1: Green travel advice, English-speaking, good healthcare; driving on the left.
opties.gozo.scores.avontuur.1: Small island with its own language and feel.
opties.gozo.onderscheid.plus.0: Only option where you can walk from the house to restaurants.
opties.gozo.onderscheid.plus.1: Combination of the warmest sea and lots of culture.
opties.gozo.onderscheid.min.1: Extra ferry and driving on the left.
opties.gozo.mogelijkheden.strand.1: Ramla Bay a 10 minute drive away.
opties.gozo.mogelijkheden.restaurants.1: The Xagħra village square a 2 minute walk away.
opties.gozo.mogelijkheden.uitgaan.1: Bars on the village squares; the real nightlife is on Malta.
opties.gozo.mogelijkheden.wijn.1: A few wine estates on Gozo, such as Ta' Mena.
opties.gozo.mogelijkheden.boot.1: To Comino's Blue Lagoon and along the caves.
opties.gozo.mogelijkheden.natuur.1: Dwejra cliffs, salt pans, coastal paths.
opties.gozo.mogelijkheden.padel.1: No court found on Gozo; there are some on Malta.
opties.gozo.mogelijkheden.watersport.1: One of the best diving and snorkelling spots in Europe.
opties.gozo.mogelijkheden.kids.1: Sandy beach at Ramla, quiet village life.
opties.gozo.mogelijkheden.hooghouden.1: Garden at the farmhouse; the village square is round the corner.
opties.gozo.kidscheck.water: Red sandy beach at Ramla, calm
opties.gozo.huizen.656440171708352758.wa: Large stone family farmhouse a 2 minute walk from the village square with restaurants. Cot, high chair, toys, fenced garden, central air con.
opties.gozo.huizen.656440171708352758.le: Restaurants are pricier here than elsewhere.
opties.gozo.huizen.53038310.waarom: Converted house of character, 5 bedrooms with en-suite bathroom, jacuzzi, fenced garden.
opties.kefalonia.tagline: The Greek island of Myrtos beach and cave lakes, and the best-rated house on the list.
opties.kefalonia.sfeer: Greek island life: tavernas, turquoise bays and sunsets from the terrace. Few crowds, lots of nature.
opties.kefalonia.scores.zon_zee.1: Sea of 24°C, small chance of a showery day.
opties.kefalonia.scores.eten.1: Greek tavernas, Kefalonian meat pie and Robola wine.
opties.kefalonia.scores.natuur.1: Myrtos, Antisamos, the Melissani and Drogarati caves.
opties.kefalonia.scores.cultuur.1: Fiskardo, Assos and a boat trip to Ithaca.
opties.kefalonia.scores.reisgemak.1: 3 hour flight and 20 minutes to the house; approx. 4 flights a week.
opties.kefalonia.scores.avontuur.1: Less well known than Crete or Corfu.
opties.kefalonia.onderscheid.plus.0: Highest-rated house of all options (4.99 from 100 reviews).
opties.kefalonia.onderscheid.plus.1: Shortest transfer of all the islands and far-off destinations.
opties.kefalonia.onderscheid.min.1: Only Transavia flies direct, not every day.
opties.kefalonia.mogelijkheden.strand.1: Lourdata beach a few minutes' drive away.
opties.kefalonia.mogelijkheden.wijn.1: Robola wineries; the harvest falls in September.
opties.kefalonia.mogelijkheden.boot.1: Melissani cave lake, boats to Ithaca and hidden bays.
opties.kefalonia.mogelijkheden.waterspor: Snorkelling and kayaking along the coast.
opties.kefalonia.mogelijkheden.kids.1: Spotting sea turtles in Argostoli harbour.
opties.kefalonia.mogelijkheden.hooghoude: Fenced garden with outdoor seating area, size unknown.
opties.kefalonia.huizen.19616034.waarom: Near-perfect score across 100 reviews, sea view, fenced garden, cot and high chair, central air con.
opties.kefalonia.huizen.555585.waarom: Direct access to the sea, views over the water, fenced garden.
opties.kefalonia.huizen.555585.let_op: Ask about the pool in late September.
opties.sicilie.tagline: Baroque towns, Modica chocolate, granita for breakfast and the best food on the list.
opties.sicilie.sfeer: A week of long meals and wandering: mornings with granita, afternoons in baroque towns or on the beach, evenings with long Sicilian dinners.
opties.sicilie.scores.value.1: Strong houses around €3,950, restaurants not cheap.
opties.sicilie.scores.eten.1: Arancini, cannoli, granita, Nero d'Avola: the best food on the list.
opties.sicilie.scores.natuur.1: Vendicari nature reserve, the Cava d'Ispica and Etna as a day trip.
opties.sicilie.scores.cultuur.1: UNESCO baroque of Noto, Modica and Ragusa, plus Ortigia.
opties.sicilie.scores.reisgemak.1: Lots of flights, but a 1h30 drive to the house.
opties.sicilie.scores.avontuur.1: Italy, but with a rugged Sicilian feel of its own.
opties.sicilie.onderscheid.plus.0: Best food and the prettiest towns of all options.
opties.sicilie.onderscheid.plus.1: Houses on old estates with lots of character.
opties.sicilie.onderscheid.min.0: Most expensive option for food and drink.
opties.sicilie.onderscheid.min.1: Longer transfer and the beach is not near the house.
opties.sicilie.mogelijkheden.strand.1: Beaches of Vendicari and Marina di Modica 25 to 30 minutes away.
opties.sicilie.mogelijkheden.restaurants: Car needed; Modica is a short drive away.
opties.sicilie.mogelijkheden.uitgaan.1: Aperitivo in Modica and Ragusa Ibla, livelier in Ortigia.
opties.sicilie.mogelijkheden.wijn.1: Cerasuolo di Vittoria and Nero d'Avola; late September is the vendemmia.
opties.sicilie.mogelijkheden.natuur.1: Vendicari, Cava d'Ispica and Etna as a long day trip.
opties.sicilie.mogelijkheden.padel.1: Padel in Marina di Ragusa, approx. 30 minutes away.
opties.sicilie.mogelijkheden.kids.1: Beach and the little tourist train in Ragusa Ibla.
opties.sicilie.huizen.15589416.waarom: Old estate in the hills of Modica, all bedrooms with en-suite bathroom, perfect score across 56 reviews, cot, fenced garden, air con.
opties.sicilie.huizen.15589416.let_op: Ask about the pool in late September.
opties.sicilie.huizen.32129242.waarom: 50 metres from the beach, 93 reviews with a 4.99.
opties.sicilie.huizen.32129242.let_op: No cot or fenced garden listed; €380 more expensive.
